headline: Growth stays strong as GAAP profitability extends further
summary_short: Samsara reported revenue of $478.8M, up 31% y/y, with GAAP net income of $44.5M lifted by a $30.3M one-time arbitration gain and GAAP EPS of $0.08 — a third straight profitable quarter.
summary_long: Revenue grew 31% y/y (29% constant-currency) to $478.8M, with ARR up 30% y/y to $1.99B and net new ARR of $100.7M. GAAP gross margin narrowed 2pts y/y to 75% while GAAP operating margin improved 11pts to 2%, aided by revenue scaling faster than opex. GAAP net income of $44.5M (EPS $0.08) included a $30.3M arbitration gain from the Motive Technologies dispute — the third straight quarter of GAAP profitability. Operating cash flow was $81.4M and adjusted free cash flow $73.2M, both up y/y. Cash and short-term investments totaled roughly $804M. For Q2 FY2027, Samsara guides revenue of $482-484M and non-GAAP EPS of $0.15-0.16; FY2027 revenue guidance is $2.005-2.013B with non-GAAP EPS of $0.70-0.72.

drivers.explanation: CEO cites strong customer demand and worker-capacity constraints driving Operational AI adoption, with ARR nearing $2B alongside a third straight quarter of GAAP profitability.
Includes a $30.3M gain from an arbitration award against Motive Technologies in a breach-of-contract and unfair-competition dispute, per company disclosure.
Gross profit grew with revenue, but GAAP gross margin narrowed 2 points y/y to 75%; the release does not explain the margin compression.
Operating margin improved 11 points to 2% because revenue grew 31% y/y while total operating expenses rose only about 12%.
